description: Full public listing for one product by slug: description, category, markets, customer type, API, pricing model, links, the company and an agent_access object (api_available, docs_url, openapi_url, sandbox_url, llms_txt_url, auth_method, mcp_url) when any is set, plus the company's lei, licences[] (with source_url and last_checked_at) and certifications[] (self-reported). Company-provided, not part of the CC BY dataset. Each result carries provided_by, last_confirmed_at and sponsored; sponsorship never changes ordering.
name: get_product
title: Get a fintech product
